tier: pay-as-you-go free tiers (payment method on file)

free_tier.stated: Temporary Geocoding API: up to 100,000 requests a month free, then USD 0.75 per 1,000; the same account gets 50,000 GL JS map loads, 200,000 Vector Tiles API requests, 200,000 Static Tiles API requests, 750,000 Raster Tiles API requests, 50,000 Static Images API requests and 100,000 Tilequery API requests a month free; Permanent Geocoding (storable results) has no free amount and costs USD 5.00 per 1,000 from the first request
free_tier.notes: these free tiers apply once a payment method is on file; an account without one is on demo access, with lower monthly caps (10,000 Temporary Geocoding requests, a batch counting one per query) and no Raster Tiles API or Permanent Geocoding. The free tier resets on the first day of each monthly billing period.

per_object_cap.stated: a forward query is at most 20 words and 256 characters; a batch request holds up to 1000 queries, each billed as one request, while the error list on the same page gives a ceiling of 50 queries per batch request

retention.notes: the Geocoding API defaults to temporary geocoding; the permanent=true parameter selects the storable, billed mode

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in requests, not bytes

interface_detail: Geocoding API v6 at api.mapbox.com/search/geocode/v6 (forward, reverse and a batch endpoint), with an access_token on every request; a request without a token gets HTTP 401 NO_TOKEN
tooling: any HTTP client with an access token; Mapbox GL JS and the Mapbox web and mobile SDKs for maps and search
chaining: Bulk path: none; the batch endpoint bills every query as one request, and no geocoding data download is published

limits.value: 1000 Geocoding API requests per minute by default, counted per access token; HTTP 429 above it
100,000 Temporary Geocoding API requests a month free, then USD 0.75 per 1,000 up to 500,000
Storable results are Permanent Geocoding at USD 5.00 per 1,000 from the first request up to 500,000 a month

binding_note: the free 100,000 a month cannot be kept, so any use that stores coordinates meets the paid Permanent Geocoding price at the first request, before the monthly quota or the 1000 per minute rate

identity_cost.detail: the free tiers apply after a payment method is added: a card, a US bank account or a stablecoin wallet; Permanent Geocoding needs a valid credit card on file. Signup without a payment method (Start without a credit card) gives demo access only, with lower usage caps and rate limits, confirmed by an emailed link valid 24 hours

reliability_note: a failed invoice charge puts the account at risk of deactivation and service interruption; the default per-token rate limit can be adjusted per account by Mapbox
confidence_note: the pricing page, the Geocoding API page, the API overview, the signup guide and the billing FAQ were quoted on 2026-10-30, and a request without a token was answered HTTP 401 NO_TOKEN; no account was opened, so no geocode was made. A keyed geocode would move it to measured.
